description:
Decoding the System. Engineering the Future.

Following the discovery of the Mars Orb, a deeper layer was revealed — a hidden structure beneath the surface of Mars. Patterns of energy, data, and motion forming an intelligent network. From this discovery, the Mars Helix was born.

The Mars Helix represents the DNA of a new world — where technology, movement, and design converge into a unified system. Its carbon road platform is engineered for precision, speed, and seamless power transfer, delivering a ride that feels both controlled and alive.

The neon grid pattern flows across the frame like an energy map — a visual expression of interconnected systems, data streams, and the invisible forces that power a new civilization.

Lightweight, responsive, and built for high-performance road riding, Mars Helix is designed for those who move with intention — riders who understand that every line, every motion, and every detail is part of something greater.

Mars Helix is not just engineered to perform.

It is engineered to connect.

Born from the decoded systems of Mars, the Mars Helix represents the DNA of a new world — where energy, data, and motion converge. Engineered in carbon for precision and speed, its neon grid design reflects the intelligent networks powering the future of cycling.
